verdict.rationale: Copilot documents AI code review that gives feedback on your code, with severity-labeled comments and one-click suggested changes. It also offers a desktop workspace to review changes and merge completed work, and agent mode can validate files. These help catch problems before merging, but explicit diff inspection and running checks or tests before merge are only implied. Missing for 10: documented diff-viewing tooling, documented execution of CI/tests or status checks before merge, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect diffs and run checks to catch problems before merging

citations.quote: GitHub Copilot can review your code and provide feedback. Where possible, Copilot's feedback includes suggested changes which you can apply with a couple of clicks.
Copilot labels each comment with a severity level of "High," "Medium," or "Low" to help you prioritize the issues it finds based on their importance.
review changes, and merge completed work—all from one desktop workspace built natively on GitHub
proposing edits and validating files with agent mode
